_comment: SSH hosts the deep-link resolver's isSshHost (deep-link.js) and the gateway's validate_ssh_host (src/kiro_crew/instances/validation.py) must agree on. deep-link.test.js runs every host through isSshHost; test/test_cli_open.py runs every host through validate_ssh_host. No sample carries surrounding whitespace, which the gateway strips and the link refuses, and every sample stays under the 255-character cap, so only the grammar is compared here.
